suggestions.s1: Review the attached file, summarize the key points and split the to-dos into tasks.
suggestions.s2: Review the current state of the project folder and prepare improvement suggestions as a report.
suggestions.s3: Which tasks were sent back for revision? Can you summarize them?

noTeam: No team assigned to the project

drop.general: Drop files — they go to the lead (or the team you choose)
drop.task: Drop files — they are added to the task

generalSubtitle: {{project}} · talk to the lead: describe the work to split it into tasks for the project team
taskSubtitle: Task thread — notes are passed to the agent on its next run

noLead.teamTitle: No team is assigned to {{project}} yet
noLead.teamText: In #general you describe work to the project's lead, who splits it into tasks for the team. Add an existing team to this project, or set one up from a template.
noLead.emptyTitle: The project's team has no agents
noLead.emptyText: Add agents to the team assigned to this project (one of them leads), or set up a ready team from a template.
noLead.offText: Every agent of this project is turned off, so no one can reply. Turn this agent (or another member) on to talk to the lead: {{name}}.

empty: No messages in this channel yet.
shareHint: The lead also opens files it attaches to tasks to whoever does the task.

live.message: writing a note to the team…
live.question: writing a question…

card.taken: Request taken; this card shows how it ends once the wait is over.
card.gone: This request isn't waiting any more.

outcome.expired: Expired: the request was turned down.
outcome.withdrawn: The request went away (the run stopped, or a related permission, agent, connection or app changed).
outcome.closed: Agentbits closed while this waited; the request ended.
outcome.restarted: A new run was created (if it needs approval, you'll be asked separately).
outcome.reviewRequested: The review was queued again; the worker didn't run.
outcome.moved: The task was changed elsewhere; this request isn't waiting any more.
outcome.superseded: The task is waiting again for a newer reason; see the newer card.
outcome.mergeGone: Nothing waits to be merged any more (no changes to merge, isolation turned off, or the working copy is gone).
outcome.allowed: ✓ Approved — the requested operation may run.

request.asked: The lead is writing the summary

question.hint: or start your message with “{{key}}:”. An answer approves nothing.

jump.gone: That card is no longer in this chat (deleted, or the chat was cleared).
